newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crude, products firm in ACCESS after APIs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crude, products firm in ACCESS after APIs.

text.p: U.S. crude oil and products prices firmed in moderate after-hours ACCESS trade on Tuesday, on slightly bullish weekly inventory reports.
NYMEX October crude traded $24.20 a barrel, up eight cents on 900 lots traded early in the session.
The American Petroleum Institute (API) reported crude stocks nationwide fell 3.33 million barrels as of September 6.
October heating oil firmed about 0.08 cent to 66.75 cents a gallon on 235 lots traded.
Front-month unleaded gasoline was indicated higher, bid 64.85 cents a gallon, asked 65.20 cents on 170 lots traded after closing at 64.85 cents a gallon in the floor session.
